results.overview: A smart, successful woman changes her perspective on how to meet the right man after her fiancé cheats on her right before the wedding.
results.name: Los caballeros las prefieren brutas

results.overview: An anime-original spin-off/sequel based on the Saint Seiya series: The god of war and guardian of his namesake planet, Mars, was once sealed away by Seiya, but time has passed and his revival is at hand. Meanwhile, Saori Kido is raising the boy Kouga, whose life Seiya saved, and he's been training every day to become a Saint in order to prepare for the coming crisis. Unaware of his destiny, when Kouga awakens to the power of his Cosmo hidden inside him, the curtain will rise upon the legend of a new Saint.
results.name: Saint Seiya Omega

results.overview: Ages ago, the goddess Athena was served by fighters called Saints who channeled the power of the Cosmos within them. Now a youth named Seiya has trained to become a Saint himself by earning the mystical Cloth of Pegasus. He is joined by other Saints with Cloths of their own to fight for Athena.
results.name: Saint Seiya

results.overview: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.
results.name: The Gentlemen

results.overview: Arabian Knights is an animated segment of The Banana Splits Adventure Hour, created by Hanna-Barbera Productions. The series is based on Arabian Nights, a classic work of Middle Eastern literature.
results.name: Arabian Knights

results.overview: On the planet Maris in the year 2387 three teen soldiers fight back against invading aliens.
results.name: Zillion

results.overview: Secrets. Mysteries. And frightening magical beings. The small town of Castelcorvo is not as rested as it seems and just a bunch of brave knight can keep it safe. Four kids - Giulia, Riccardo, Betta and Matteo - will have to solve mysterious enigmas and face their greatest fears to become the paladins who fight the evil that lurks in Castelcorvo.
results.name: The Knights of Castelcorvo

results.overview: Baba Lamunade is followed home by two strange peddler girls who give him a CD-rom game. After he beats "The Legend of Lamuness", the girls come out of his computer and bring him to DokiDoki Space. He is the third descendant of the hero Lamuness who must stop Don Genosai from resurrecting the great evil Abraham. Accompanied by PQ, his advisor robot, and Parfait and Cacao, he must pilot the Kaizer Fire mecha. However, he needs another pilot, and Da Cider is chosen as the second pilot.
results.name: VS Knight Lamune & 40 Fire

results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 セインティア翔
results.overview: The whole Sanctuary was misled into danger due to the civil war instigated by the Gemini Gold Saint, Saga. Our story begins right after the end of those events... This is a story of the girls protecting Athena. These are the records of love and fierce fights they meet while opposing destiny on their way to maturity...
results.name: Saint Seiya: Saintia Sho

results.overview: To save the galaxy from impending doom, Cacao and Parfait are sent on a mission through time and space to retrieve the Fourth Warrior, Lamunes. Unfortunately, Cacao and Parfait discover Lamunes at the helm of the marauding Giga Genos invasion fleet. World by world, Lamunes is determined to bring the entire galaxy under his tyrannical heel. With the help of a plucky orphan, it’s up to Cacao and Parfait to stop Lamunes from taking over the world. Action,comedy,and endless fan service!
results.name: VS Knight Lamune & 40 Fresh

results.overview: Teenager Kit Taylor discovers a mysterious deck of Advent Cards that grant him the power to transform into an ancient armored warrior called a Kamen Rider.  He joins Kamen Rider comrade Wing Knight to battle the renegade warlord General Xaviax and his army in both the real world and an alternate reality called Ventara, or Mirror World.
results.name: Kamen Rider: Dragon Knight

results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 冥王ハーデス
results.overview: Hades is planning to take over the world, to achieve that goal, he sends out deceased Gold Saints to take Athena's head. Seiya and the other Bronze Saints come to help but their help isn't appreciated by the remaining Gold Saints that are still alive.
results.name: Saint Seiya: The Hades Chapter

results.overview: What secrets did the Knights Templar leave behind? Timothy Hogan and Scott Wolter reveal hidden ties to Atlantis, Egypt, and ancient mysteries.
results.name: Mysteries of the Knights Templar

results.original_name: King Arthur & the Knights of Justice
results.overview: The magical Merlin uses his wizardry to transport a modern-day squad of football players into the olden days of King Arthur in order to battle evil.
results.name: King Arthur & the Knights of Justice

results.original_name: SAINT SEIYA: Knights of the Zodiac
results.overview: Seiya and the Knights of the Zodiac rise again to protect the reincarnation of the goddess Athena, but a dark prophecy hangs over them all.
results.name: SAINT SEIYA: Knights of the Zodiac

results.original_name: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士
results.overview: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?
results.name: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom

results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 THE LOST CANVAS 冥王神話
results.overview: The Sacred war tale that took place during the 18th century is now unveiled. Tenma, Alone and Sasha, three orphans living their childhood protecting each other and then separated at diferent ages made a pact to meet again. Find themselves again connected but now in roles they never saw as posible. Pegasus, Hades and Athena. Its now time to fight but destiny can be bitter since war between Athena and Hades forces can put old friends and families face to face.
results.name: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas
